purpose: Runtime values for the existing session-meta queue/readback consumers.

required.asset_id: Registered wendangwang asset id; never inferred.
required.base_token: User-owned Bitable base token; never stored in the public bundle.
required.table_id: User-owned Bitable table id; never stored in the public bundle.
required.from_session: The registered caller session allowed by the asset contract.
required.queue_db: Absolute user-owned queue database path; never omitted to use a private default.
required.registry_glob: Absolute user-owned asset registry glob; never omitted to use a private default.
required.lark_cli: Existing lark-cli executable used only for read-back.
required.lark_identity: Explicit lark-cli identity, normally bot or user.
required.receipt_path: Absolute path outside FP_ROOT for the terminal receipt.

optional.state_dir: External directory used by sync-session-table.sh when output is omitted.
optional.status_entrypoint: Existing feishu-sync-status executable for a non-waiting queue wrapper.
optional.remote_fixture: Controlled local read fixture; never a production fallback.

defaults: No remote coordinates, executable paths, identity, or output path are defaulted.
forbidden: queue operation other than bitable_rows_create_if_absent for seed
